question: Upon what seat and into what state did Parama Bhairava enter?
premises: Parama Bhairava was seated upon a serpent seat.
Parama Bhairava entered the state of yogic sleep.
This action continues the account of Parama Bhairava in the primordial ocean.
inference: Parama Bhairava assumed a seated posture on the serpent seat and entered yogic sleep.
plain_english: Seated on the serpent-seat, he entered yogic sleep.
